checks.detail: Bounded 10 USDT stock-token execution succeeded; post-swap allowance is zero.
Three BNB Chain contracts have matching receipts, runtime bytecode, relationships, and BscScan sources.
The live EIP-712 Credential is bound to the deployed ContinuityRegistry and deployment evidence root.
The Passport exposes quoteFresh as the sole challenge instead of inferring an unprovable broadcast time.
An independent consumer permits monitoring but blocks deposits and automated rescue.
Public summary roots match deployment, Credential, Passport, and consumer artifacts.
The wallet-free browser verifier independently recomputes all published roots.
Wallets, agents, and protocols can integrate without importing the UI.
Manifest, 0.01 USDT pricing, authentication boundary, and deterministic invocation fixtures are ready to publish without claiming deployment.
Tests, compilation, package build, security audit, and this readiness audit run in CI.
No credential or private-key pattern is present in public artifacts.

payload.truthNotice: TECHNICALLY_READY covers the reproducible repository, public demo, mainnet execution, source-verified contracts, Registry-bound Credential, Passport, and independent consumer. It does not claim an Agent Studio deployment receipt or a completed submission video.
